# ctables/ne

> Inequality: `!=`, by value; strings by content.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/ne.pkg) · translates [std/ne](../std/ne.md)

Strings go through `__pk_streq` from [streq](streq.md); every other
type compares the words.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when left str`

```nasm
@binop
!__pk_streq({L.a}, {L.b}); })
@streq
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
{L.a} != {L.b}; })
```

Includes: [ctables/binop](binop.md), [ctables/streq](streq.md)
